scientific_integrity: The new finite-field count and Frobenius refinement are proved using cited published geometric inputs. Finite checks are not represented as infinite proofs. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact zeta function concerns the smooth proper crepant algebraic-space self-product resolution, not the later projective Kummer quotient; uses previously established resolution geometry, Betti numbers and quadratic-extension count. Some less accessible specialist work may affect historical priority.
title: Frobenius descent and the zeta function of a characteristic-five resolved elliptic self-product
